entries.6c16a876f72d85d7: In North America the company has built a structure as a hose manufacturer that handles research, development, manufacturing and sales in an integrated manner, and its strength lies in its supply function through logistics bases across North America. In Japan the company supplies urea SCR modules, tanks and other products as a Tier1 supplier to agricultural and construction machinery manufacturers, and is strengthening research and development functions across the group, centered on Kuriyama R&D Co., Ltd., which was reorganized in fiscal 2024.
entries.79d2c96416a6ea68: In March 2025 the company announced its long-term vision 'KURIYAMA MANAGEMENT PLAN (KMP) 2039', aimed at maximizing corporate value in 2039, the year marking its 100th anniversary of founding, and, as its concrete implementation, the medium-term management plans 'KMP Action1 (2025–2027)' and 'KMP Action2 (2028–2030)'. In the Industrial Materials Business, the company will maximize synergies with Mitoyo Co., Ltd., which became part of the group in April 2025, and work to establish a position as a global Tier1 supplier to construction machinery, agricultural machinery and commercial vehicle manufacturers; in the Sports and Construction Materials Business, it will expand sales of the elastic sports sheet 'Tarafrex' and strengthen the brand of comprehensive flooring for sports and commercial facilities. In the North America Business, the company states that it will advance local production for local consumption by optimizing logistics functions and newly building and expanding hose production lines.
